titre: Box-office d'été en Amérique du Nord
sous_titre: Recettes des salles, saison d'été, en Mds $ (saison 2026 mesurée sur 130 jours)

2024.texte: Domestic box office reached $3.68bn for the summer (first Friday in May to Labor Day Monday) in 2024.

2025.texte: will be $3.67 billion. That's 0.2% down from the total recorded in summer 2024

2026.texte: biggest of all time by a slender margin on $4.765bn to overtake the $4.756bn milestone established in 2013
